entry.summary: Introduces READY, a qualification framework that asks whether an agent meets reliability targets under human oversight and cost constraints, preserving each workflow own success definition. Shifts focus from benchmark completion to deployability.

entry.title: Diagnosing with Insights: Structured Analysis of Agent Failures via Behavioral Abstractions

author.name: Jiayi Bi, Yanjie Gao, Yuanmin Xie, Liqun Li, Tianyin Xu, Fan Yang, Mao Yang

entry.summary: Introduces AGENTSCOPE, a neuro-symbolic approach that abstracts long agent trajectories into structured behavioral representations for failure diagnosis. Combines symbolic abstractions with model-based analysis to avoid pure LLM-as-judge unreliability.

entry.title: Ranked by the Matcher: A Reproducibility Audit of Knowledge Graph Extraction from Threat Reports

author.name: Safayat Bin Hakim, Houbing Herbert Song

entry.summary: Audits knowledge graph extraction from threat reports, showing matching protocol choice flips many pairwise rankings and spans 0.16 to 0.70 F1 on fixed outputs. Finds only an LLM judge approaches human adjudication and releases deterministic CTIForge to isolate effects.

entry.title: HEAT: Faster Fully Homomorphic Inference via Approximations-Weights Co-Adaptation

author.name: Alessandro Zirilli, Davide Marincione, Evgenios M. Kornaropoulos, Giuseppe Ateniese, Emanuele Rodol\`a

entry.summary: Proposes HEAT, which co-adapts per-layer approximation iteration counts and weights to cut costly bootstraps in fully homomorphic encrypted LLM inference. Tailors precision to each nonlinearity tolerance instead of uniform settings.

entry.title: Interpretable Symptom Vectors for Depression in a Large Language Model

author.name: Fangyi Zhu, Ajay Subramanian, Allison Constant, Camille Wang, Ravish Gupta, Corey J. Keller

entry.summary: Studies how depressive symptoms are encoded in the residual stream of existing open model Gemma-3-27B-PT, finding strongest separation at layer 21. Uses mechanistic tools to link internal vectors to clinician judged symptom groups.

category.term: Interpretability Culture and Human Centered Evaluation

entry.title: GeoSPRINT: Geometric Redundancy-Aware Step Pruning for Inference in Diffusion Trajectories

author.name: Arpita Joshi

entry.summary: Proposes GeoSPRINT, a training free method that prunes redundant diffusion sampling steps using hyperplanarity tests via QR factorization. Allocates more steps to geometrically complex trajectory regions.

entry.title: Percolation Dynamics in Optimization : Variance Cascades and Discrete Scale Invariance

author.name: Sai Niranjan Ramachandran, Suvrit Sra

entry.summary: Models SGD stochastic flow as percolation where symmetries cause subnetworks to merge in blocks, producing variance spikes. Extends cascade view to Adam and AdamW under heavy tailed noise.

entry.title: HiPoly: a hierarchical polymer-native AI framework for property prediction and generative design

author.name: Ge Sun, Gervasio Zaldivar, Yuan Tian, Gustavo Perez Lemus, Juhae Park, Dasha Safarian, Ming Han, Juan J. de Pablo

entry.summary: Presents HiPoly, a hierarchical graph framework for polymers that encodes monomer connectivity, composition and molecular weight across scales. Targets property prediction and generative design for energy, health and transport materials. Shows domain-native architecture for difficult multiscale structures.

entry.title: Prompt-Space Meta-Learning Does Not Transfer Across Users: A Frozen-LLM Negative Result

author.name: Liam Byrne, David Dylan, Orla Fitzgerald, Eoin Doyle, Ciara Nolan, Padraig Lynch, Sinead Gallagher

entry.summary: Reports a negative result that prompt-space meta-learning with a shared evolved adaptation prompt does not transfer across users for frozen LLMs. Shows gains reflect generic instruction quality rather than learned personalization. Important caution for personalization claims.

entry.title: SoK: Where Do Flow Labels Come From? Auditing Label Provenance in Encrypted Traffic Benchmarks

author.name: Sizhe Huang, Shujie Yang

entry.summary: Systematizes label provenance in encrypted traffic classification across 14 benchmark entries. Identifies coarse inheritance that over labels flows and overstrict filtering that discards relevant flows, with no countable preselection population. Finds task definitions disagree with recovered records in most cases.

entry.title: Improved Gradient Descent Lower Bounds Beyond Nesterov

author.name: Yuhan Ye, Kaizhao Liu

entry.summary: Proves stronger lower bounds for gradient descent with predetermined stepsizes in smooth convex optimization, improving non anytime and anytime exponents. Establishes strict separation between settings alongside silver schedules. Advances classic optimization complexity.

entry.title: SpeakPay: Domain-Adaptive LoRA Fine-Tuning of Whisper for Low-Resource Nepali Financial Speech Recognition

author.name: Biraj Subedi

entry.summary: Presents SpeakPay, a voice first wallet plus LoRA adaptation of Whisper large-v2 for Nepali financial speech with a 403 utterance dataset. Cuts word error rate from about 130 percent to about 43 percent and lifts Devanagari numeral accuracy from zero to 74 percent. Centers accessibility for visually impaired users.

entry.title: MemeCULT-1K: Benchmarking South Asian Cultural Context and Humor Understanding of Multimodal Models

author.name: Tawsif Tashwar Dipto, Mehedi Ahamed, Radib Bin Kabir, Mueeze Al Mushabbir, Mohammed Saidul Islam, Mir Rayat Imtiaz Hossain, Md Tahmid Rahman Laskar, Sabbir Ahmed

entry.summary: Introduces MemeCULT-1K, a 1,000 meme benchmark in Bengali, English, and Hindi with cultural notes and human explanations plus dialect memes. Evaluates thirteen vision language models meme only versus context aware. Shows minimal cultural context consistently boosts similarity and quality metrics.

entry.title: Efficient GUI Agents: A Systems Survey of Observation, Memory, Action, and Runtime Optimization

author.name: Bizhe Bai, Jiakang Yuan, Hongming Wu, Xinyue Wang, Jie Ren, Siyao Chen, Yuchen Ya, Fan Bai, Pai Peng, Huafeng Qin, Tao Chen

entry.summary: Surveys efficient GUI agents across websites, mobile, and desktop through observation, memory, action, and runtime lenses. Synthesizes mechanisms and efficiency signals beyond task success via citation chaining. Argues deployment depends on context and compute budgets as much as accuracy.

entry.title: ZipTok3D: High-Fidelity 3D Tokenization with Compact Token Prefixes

author.name: Mingda Lin, Weijie Wang, Zeyu Zhang, Bowen Cui, Yefei He, Haoyu Zhao, Yuanyu He, Donny Y. Chen, Feng Chen, Bohan Zhuang

entry.summary: Introduces ZipTok3D, a 3D tokenizer that organizes geometry into progressively informative global token prefixes with iterative decoding. Uses nested dropout during training so short prefixes still reconstruct well. Enables high-fidelity reconstruction under extremely low token budgets for efficient 3D generation.

entry.title: SignMatch: Matching Dictionary Signs to Continuous Sign Language Video

author.name: Ryan Wong, Youngjoon Jang, Liliane Momeni, G\"ul Varol, Andrew Zisserman

entry.summary: Learns a prototype-structured embedding space from continuous signing video to match isolated dictionary signs by visual similarity of handshape and motion. Maps dictionary exemplars into same space to support unseen signs. Evaluated on ASL dictionary retrieval and spotting.

entry.title: Towards Zero-Shot Transfer Across Embodiments For Driving VLAs

author.name: Caio Azevedo, Stefano Sabatini, Sascha Hornauer, Fabien Moutarde

entry.summary: Studies zero-shot transfer of vision-language-action driving models across datasets and camera rigs, finding naive multi-dataset mixing does not guarantee gains. Explores unified representations across embodiments inspired by manipulation results. Highlights cross-embodiment gap in driving.

entry.title: CA-OPD: Confidence-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Structured Visual Prediction

author.name: Menghao Li, Linjie Mu, Yin Wang, Haotian Hu, Yannian Gu, Lujiayi Xue, Fanyi Wang

entry.summary: Introduces CA-OPD, a confidence-aware on-policy distillation method for autoregressive vision-language perception that uses teacher confidence to guide intervention and token supervision. Mitigates compounding errors from unreliable student rollouts versus rigid ranking. Structured prediction focus.

entry.title: WiFlow: Estimating Optical Flow using WiFi Channel State Information

author.name: Thomas Weigel, Simon Kiefhaber, Fabian Portner, Matthias Hollick, Simone Schaub-Meyer

entry.summary: Introduces WiFlow for optical flow estimation from WiFi channel state information instead of cameras for privacy and lighting robustness. Provides a preprocessor study, three accuracy-complexity architectures and the first CSI flow dataset. Opens device-free motion sensing.

entry.title: CircuitsDNA: Discovering Unconventional Multi-Accuracy Arithmetic Circuits via Evolutionary Synthesis

author.name: Ruichen Qi, Junyi Luo, Xinting Jiang, Quan Cheng, Gregory Kielian, Ben Laurie, Dennis Sylvester, Mehdi Saligane

entry.summary: Introduces CircuitsDNA evolutionary synthesis of accuracy-configurable arithmetic circuits supporting multiple modes in one circuit. Uses multi-threshold verifiability miter and resource-limited search to enforce mode accuracies efficiently. Targets edge AI accuracy-efficiency tradeoffs.

entry.title: DocHop: Benchmarking Out-of-domain Multi-hop Reasoning in Information-Dense Documents

author.name: Zhuoran Yu, Le Thien Phuc Nguyen, Jaden Park, Xinyi Gu, Zexue He, Soochahn Lee, Rogerio Feris, Yong Jae Lee

entry.summary: Introduces DocHop, a benchmark for integrated chart plus narrative reasoning in document-style images requiring multi-step constraint resolution across text and charts. Tests whether models can select and aggregate visual evidence guided by narrative.

entry.title: LLM-as-a-Judge Is Not an Oracle: Why Self-Improving Agents Need Deterministic Guardrails

author.name: Vansh Wahi

entry.summary: Argues from production prompt-optimization experience that LLM judges should be advisors gated by deterministic verification, cataloging eleven evaluation failures across contract, compliance, and code tasks. Advocates a verification layer judges cannot override.

entry.title: Knowing Is Not Enough: Information Retrievability as a Precondition to Effective LLM Oversight

author.name: Xinyu Fu, Narayan Ramasubbu, Dennis Galletta

entry.summary: Argues human oversight of LLMs depends on retrievability of verification info at review time, not just capability. Two field experiments with 640 employees show self generated explanations and reactivation cues improve error detection.

category.term: Interpretability Culture and Human Centered Evaluation

entry.title: InfraPatch: Cross-Task Targeted Grayscale Patch Attacks on Infrared-Adapted Vision-Language Models

author.name: Chengyin Hu, Dingyi Lu, Jiaju Han, Xiang Chen, Weiwen Shi, Jiahuan Long, Yiwei Wei, Jiujiang Guo

entry.summary: Introduces InfraPatch, a white box targeted grayscale patch attack within 5 percent area against infrared vision language models. Shows localized perturbations can induce intended semantics across classification and related tasks.

entry.title: VoRTeC: Taming Foundation Flow for One-step Real time Video Compression

author.name: Yichong Xia, Qinhong Wu, Qinhong Wu, Jinpeng Wang, Zeyuan Chen, Haoqian Wang

entry.summary: Proposes VoRTeC for ultra low bitrate video compression built on foundation flow model Wan2.1. Encodes compact latents and predicts positions along flow trajectories with multiscale priors for one step real time decoding.

entry.title: Towards One-for-All Robustness Across a Continuum of Threat Levels

author.name: Zhichao Hou, Xiaorui Liu

entry.summary: Proposes Threat Conditional Network factorizing into shared backbone plus Fourier conditioned adaptor for robustness across perturbation levels. Trains against threat distribution to avoid one model per budget.

entry.title: Compositional Spectral Prompts for LLM-based Online Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Seungyoon Choi, Hyunchul Kim, Jae-Gil Lee, Chanyoung Park

entry.summary: Proposes CoSPOT, an online time series forecaster that keeps LLM frozen and adapts via compositional spectral prompts grounded in frequency bases. Handles nonstationarity and unseen patterns without memory retrieval. Leverages LLM few-shot ability efficiently.

entry.title: Learning the Constitutive Behavior of Materials via Neural Operators and Causal Attention: Case Studies in Plasticity and Damage

author.name: Rishabh Arora, Lisa Scheunemann, Tim Brepols, Shahed Rezaei

entry.summary: Treats materials as operators mapping full strain history to stress via neural operators with causal attention, avoiding explicit internal variables for plasticity and damage. Learns path-dependent response directly from measured data. Advances data-driven constitutive modeling.

entry.title: AVERT: Audio-Verified Adjudication for Spoken Dialogue State Tracking

author.name: Chunggi Lee, Hanspeter Pfister

entry.summary: Proposes AVERT for spoken dialogue state tracking that combines cross turn agreement with an audio conditioned verifier. Adds vote, add, and swap operators to fix inconsistent, omitted, and unsupported values beyond text only editing. Lifts joint goal accuracy substantially on SpokenWOZ.

entry.title: WinoQueer-NL: Assessing Bias in Dutch Language Models toward LGBTQ+ Identities

author.name: Jiska Beuk, Gerasimos Spanakis

entry.summary: Builds WinoQueer-NL, a 42,906 sentence Dutch benchmark for anti queer bias validated with 43 queer participants and expanded with new stereotypes. Evaluates Dutch and multilingual masked and autoregressive models. Addresses gap beyond English bias testing.

entry.title: SCULPT: Training Edge Vision Models for Post-Training Quantization Readiness

author.name: Bharadwaj Kavuri, Sourav Babu-PK, Varadhraj Ellapan, Pullarao Maddu, Prasad Deshpande

entry.summary: Proposes SCULPT, a training-time method that shapes activation distributions to be ready for low-bit post-training quantization without quantization-aware training. Uses statistical clipping and uniformity objectives during standard fine-tuning. Aims to simplify edge vision deployment.

entry.title: Rendering-in-the-Loop: An Execution-Driven Agent for Interactive Web Development

author.name: Yilong Guo, Hanqi Chen, Zixiao Ye, Guanzhong Wang, Chen Yu, Zeyu Chen

entry.summary: Presents RILA, an execution-driven agent that iteratively fixes generated webpages by replaying reference interactions in a real browser and observing runtime feedback. Adds verification and rendering modules to check interactive functionality beyond visual similarity. Advances multimodal web development.

entry.title: Characterizing Text Branch Sensitivity in Medical Vision-Language Segmentation via Evidence Decoupling

author.name: Ziquan Liu, Zhewei Zhu, Xuyang Shi

entry.summary: Systematically probes how much text helps medical vision-language segmentation and finds performance largely insensitive to fusion choice. Proposes Evidence Decoupling Decoder with evidential learning to separate image and text-modulated evidence. Suggests text role is overstated.

entry.title: GaLe: memory-efficient Global Approximate and Local Exact features

author.name: Alberto Ancilotto, Elisabetta Farella

entry.summary: Proposes GaLe, a retraining-free memory-efficient inference method splitting features into local exact and global approximate parts. Preserves long-range and attention behavior unlike tiling while matching exact accuracy on ImageNet. Enables hybrid CNN-transformers on constrained devices.

entry.title: Incoherent AI Identities can also be Stable

author.name: Ashe Vazquez Nuñez

entry.summary: Extends Artificial Self identity-stability experiments to show incoherent system-prompt identities can remain stably preferred even when coherent switches are offered. Finds the pattern expected in weaker models but still present in smarter existing models such as GPT-5.2 and Claude Opus 4.6, proposing a three-layer view of AI cognitive dissonance. Matters for persona robustness and evaluation.

entry.title: Looped Transformers under the Jacobian Lens: Does the Global Workspace Survive Recurrence?

author.name: Wenlong Wang, Fergal Reid

entry.summary: Extends the Jacobian lens to looped and recurrent transformers to test whether a mid-depth global workspace survives weight sharing across depth. Applies lens fitting and causal experiments to Ouro-2.6B looped 4 times and a small recurrent core.

entry.title: ToolGate: An Executable Acceptance Pipeline for Tool-Dependent Scientific Benchmark Construction

author.name: Ke Zhang, Yankang Liu, Roya Zandi, Maziar Raissi

entry.summary: Proposes ToolGate, an acceptance pipeline for automatically generated scientific benchmarks that keeps only items requiring specialist software to solve and that models cannot answer without it. Treats generation as proposal plus executable verification.

entry.title: Harness Engineering in LLM Tool Use via Agent-Native Reusable Tool Primitives

author.name: Haibo Jin, Suijin Wang, Xucheng Yu, Haojing Luo, Haohan Wang

entry.summary: Introduces Tool Primitives that wrap each tool with an LLM interface using natural language for invocation, handling schema resolution internally to enable nested and multi-turn calls. Aims to fix brittleness and degradation under large tool catalogs.

entry.title: Sparse Readout Prism: Explaining Logit-Lens Scores in Features Instead of Tokens

author.name: Matteo He, William F. Shen, Xinchi Qiu, Nicholas D. Lane

entry.summary: Shows logit lens readings depend on fitting corpus, termed corpus conditionality, then introduces Sparse Readout Prism to decompose readout weights into sparse features. Allows token logits to be explained as feature contributions without corpus fitting.

category.term: Interpretability Culture and Human Centered Evaluation

entry.title: Git4Data: Database-Native Version Control for AI Agents

author.name: Hongshen Gou, Zuyu Zhang, Yuze Sun, Peng Xu, Feng Tian, Long Wang, Jianguo Wang

entry.summary: Presents Git4Data, a database native version control layer exposing Git style snapshot, branch, diff and merge over SQL for parallel agentic exploration. Keeps candidate data states isolated, reproducible and auditable.

entry.title: Learn from Whoever Is Right: Answer-Verified Multi-Teacher Distillation for Multi-Domain LLMs

author.name: Xixiang He, Xingming Li, Baiqi Wu, Qiyao Sun, Xuanyu Ji, Ao Cheng, Qingyong Hu

entry.summary: Introduces MT-SDPO that routes each sample to whichever frozen teacher is actually correct via answer verification rather than domain label. Unifies multi domain strengths into one deployable model with on policy distillation.

entry.title: FlashKAN: B-Spline KANs via Truncated Power Form

author.name: Naveen Mysore

entry.summary: Proposes FlashKAN to accelerate B-spline KANs by replacing Cox-de Boor recursion with truncated power form fused via torch compile into single kernel. Removes span lookup and scatter overhead that dominates forward pass. Makes edge-activation networks more practical.

entry.title: Scalable Bayesian Optimization of Composite Functions for Image-Based Inverse Problems in Materials Characterization

author.name: Dasol Yoon, Poompol Buathong, Chia-Hao Lee, Yujia Zhang, David A. Muller, Peter I. Frazier

entry.summary: Proposes scalable Bayesian optimization of composite functions for inferring thickness and mistilt from PACBED images without extensive pretraining. Uses simulation-efficient acquisition for expensive physics simulators in electron microscopy. Improves data-efficient materials characterization.

entry.title: Source Distribution Estimation by Posterior Averaging

author.name: Trung-Dung Hoang, Lisa M. Koch

entry.summary: Solves source distribution estimation via expectation maximization that retrains amortized posterior on fresh simulations from current source then averages over observations. Avoids reliance on single fixed surrogate prior. Improves simulator calibration where surrogate is inaccurate.

entry.title: Pushing Forward Multi-Secret-Key Homomorphic Encryption for Private Average Aggregation

author.name: Miguel Morona-M\'inguez, Fernando P\'erez-Gonz\'alez, Alberto Pedrouzo-Ulloa

entry.summary: Advances multi key homomorphic encryption for private federated aggregation without strong non collusion assumptions. Focuses on reducing smudging noise and ciphertext costs during collaborative decryption for average aggregation. Matters for practical cross silo learning with sensitive updates.

entry.title: TalkFa: A Unified Benchmark for Farsi Dialogue Generation and Understanding

author.name: Neda Jamshidi, Kamyar Zeinalipour, Fahimeh Akbari, Monica Bianchini, Marco Maggini, Marco Gori

entry.summary: Introduces TalkFa, a unified Farsi dialogue benchmark with Wikipedia grounded, daily, and theatrical subsets totaling about 13K dialogues, all human reviewed after LLM assistance. Tests Llama and Mistral variants showing LoRA gains with fraction of data. Serves over 120M speakers lacking resources.

entry.title: Candidate Generation and Definition-Guided Verification for Sentence-Level Depression Symptom Recognition

author.name: Weiming Li, Catarina Barata, Miguel Constante, Joao Sanches

entry.summary: Proposes two stage depression symptom recognition separating candidate generation by contrastive encoder from definition grounded verification by fine tuned LM. Checks each sentence plus context against diagnostic definitions. Outperforms encoder, medical, and general LLM baselines.

entry.title: Incremental Pooled LLM Evaluation for Cost-Effective Retrieval Model Selection

author.name: Max Nelson, Hanoz Bhathena, Aviral Joshi, Saket Sharma

entry.summary: Studies incremental pooled LLM judging for selecting retrieval models for production RAG, judging only new documents when new systems arrive and reusing judgments. Validates on four benchmarks and a 62-configuration financial QA deployment. Offers cost-effective repeatable comparison.

entry.title: CC-4DGS: Computational Deformation and Point-Cloud Compression for Storage-Efficient Dynamic Gaussian Splatting

author.name: Kyungdae Park, Chae Eun Rhee

entry.summary: Presents CC-4DGS, a storage-efficient dynamic Gaussian splatting framework replacing large hash tables with deterministic encoding and compact decoders plus point-cloud compression. Cuts deformation storage to few megabytes while maintaining view synthesis quality. Addresses scaling of 4D scenes.

entry.title: If It Moves, Radar Knows: A Physics-Aware Radar Transformer for Class-Agnostic Moving-Object Detection

author.name: Yinghao Sun, Shuguang Li, Jinliang Shao, Tieshan Li

entry.summary: Presents PART, a sparse radar-only detector for class-agnostic moving objects that predicts existence, surface point and velocity using Doppler-aware queries. Avoids closed-set boxes to catch rare movers and remain robust in poor weather and lighting. Collision-relevant perception.

entry.title: The Diagnosis a Reporter Leaves Unspoken: Surfacing Frozen Tumor Features for Brain-Tumor MRI Reporting

author.name: Khawaja Murad ul Hassan, Ruqiyya Adil, Adil Qayyum, Rida Hassan, Asad Mansoor Khan, Muhammad Usman Akram, Mehran Ebrahimi

entry.summary: Shows a brain-MRI report generator built on an existing medical language backbone often misnames tumor types while frozen segmentation features still encode diagnosis linearly separable. Proposes NeuroFusion to surface latent features via classifier heads and draft-review decoding. Diagnostic silence analysis.

entry.title: Stereo 4D Radar for 3D Object Detection: Integrating Geometric Alignment and Absolute Velocity Estimation

author.name: Seung-Hyun Song, Dong-Hee Paek, Woong-Chan Byun, Seung-Hyun Kong

entry.summary: Proposes stereo 4D radar fusion for 3D object detection with geometric alignment and absolute velocity estimation. Addresses clutter, sparsity and radial-only Doppler limits under diverse weather. Strengthens radar perception beyond lidar-camera.

entry.title: Physics-Driven Independent Pair Generation for Iterative Self-Supervised Low-Dose CT Denoising

author.name: Xianlei Han, Shaoyu Wang, Jiancheng Fang, Weiwen Wu, Qiegen Liu

entry.summary: Proposes physics-driven self-supervised low-dose CT denoising that explicitly separates Poisson and Gaussian components via learned sinogram prior. Uses binomial and Gaussian thinning to create independent pairs with cross-domain iteration. Better aligns with real CT noise.

entry.title: The Missing Temporal Link: Temporal Context Routing for Script-Driven Audio-Video Generation

author.name: Yichen Liu, Quanwei Zhang, Haozhe Wang, Donghao Zhou, Xiaojie Li, Yang Shi, Jiaming Liu, Ruihua Huang, Yingtian Zou, Daquan Zhou

entry.summary: Proposes temporal context routing to align script-specified shot transitions and dialogue timing with shared audio-video temporal axes. Fixes cases where modalities sync to each other but drift from narrative. Improves script-driven generation coherence.

entry.title: From Multi-Fisheye Sensing to Panoramic Perception: A Parallax-Aware Onboard Platform for Ultra-Low-Altitude UAVs

author.name: Dun Dai, Ze Lu, Cheng He, Yaowen Wang, Quan Quan

entry.summary: Builds carbon-fiber platform fusing four synchronized fisheyes into 1280x640 equirectangular panorama with parallax-aware seams and photometric fusion on Jetson Orin NX. Offers accuracy and sensor-rate profiles for ultra-low-altitude UAVs. Open interface for surround vision.

entry.title: System helps humans predict when self-driving cars will make mistakes

author.name: Adam Zewe | MIT News

entry.summary: Reports MIT and Motional Concept-Wrapper Network that translates opaque driving planner reasoning into faithful human concepts like approaching stopped vehicle without harming performance. Shows explanations helped safety drivers anticipate mistakes in track tests. Matters for explainability in safety-critical autonomy.

entry.title: Epistemic Sybil Resistance: Multiplying AI Agents Without Multiplying Evidence

author.name: Marc Bara

entry.summary: Formalizes the epistemic Sybil problem where multiple agent reports appear independent but share the same underlying evidence. Shows no report-only aggregator can separate replication from corroboration and analyzes redundancy under a shared-root model.

entry.title: CoMerge: Conflict-Driven Preference Optimization for Multi-Task Model Merging

author.name: Mingjie Zheng, Zihao Chen, Wenqing Chen, Weile Yuan, Zhixuan Chu, Jianxing Yu, Zibin Zheng

entry.summary: Reframes model merging as preference optimization where defects of naive merging serve as self-supervised hard negatives. Learns to prefer merged behavior that preserves expert capabilities and reduces interference.

entry.title: Zeta-Lite: A Concurrent, Branchable In-Browser SQL Database for Agentic Memory

author.name: Gene Zhang

entry.summary: Presents zeta-lite, a WebAssembly in-browser SQL engine supporting concurrent transactions, graph queries and branching for local first apps. Addresses limits of PGlite single backend model for agentic memory use.

entry.title: Disease Burden over Skin Tone: Decomposing the Dermatology-AI Generalization Gap

author.name: Nirajan Kunwor, Sanjaya Poudel, Quoc-Huy Trinh, Jahidul Arafat, Sunil Kumar Gaire

entry.summary: Disentangles whether dermatology AI failures come from skin tone shift or disease distribution shift using tone stratified matched sets. Tests cancer trained ResNet plus foundation models DermLIP, MONET and DINOv3.

entry.title: Auditory Illusion Benchmark for Large Audio Language Models

author.name: Hayoon Kim, Eunice Hong, Kyogu Lee

entry.summary: Introduces AIB, the first auditory illusion benchmark for large audio language models covering ten music, sound and speech illusions. Pairs model tests with human listening studies to compare perceptual biases.

category.term: Interpretability Culture and Human Centered Evaluation

entry.title: DiDrive: A Risk-Aware Hierarchical Diffusion Framework for Safe Offline Reinforcement Learning in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Qisong Guo, Jingtang Chen, Zhilin Chen, Pei Xu, Mingjian Fu, Wenxi Liu, Yuanlong Yu

entry.summary: Proposes DiDrive, a risk-aware hierarchical diffusion plus offline RL framework for autonomous driving to handle distribution shift, heavy-tailed risk and redundant states. Combines risk-gated encoding with constrained policy optimization. Targets safer offline learning for driving.

category.term: Agents, Reinforcement Learning and Test-Time Compute

entry.title: Bayes-Optimal BER and AUC: Estimation and Evaluation of Estimators

author.name: Ryota Ushio, Takashi Ishida, Masashi Sugiyama

entry.summary: Extends Bayes-optimal performance estimation from accuracy to balanced error and AUC using soft labels for imbalanced and noisy settings. Provides estimators to separate irreducible error from model deficiency. Helps judge headroom more faithfully.

entry.title: Private Computation Space: Experience with Trusted Multi-Cluster Federated Learning for Agriculture

author.name: Shuangyu Lei, Muhammad Salman Abid, Jacob Belding, Sam Mosher, Manushi B. Trivedi, Shivranjani Baruah, Liam Wickes-Do, Andrew Anderson, Braulio Dumba, Alyssa Whitcraft, Ritvik Sahajpal, Sijin Li, Kelly Robbins, Michael Gore, Margaret Frank, Steven Wolf, Liz Jones, Abraham Stroock, Kaitlin Gold, Hakim Weatherspoon

entry.summary: Presents Private Computation Space, a deployed open source federated learning system for agriculture across multiple clusters. Addresses farmer privacy concerns, commodity hardware, and fragile rural connectivity while preserving model utility. Matters as a real deployment tackling adoption barriers cited by most US farmers.

entry.title: Hardware-Accelerated Instance Segmentation for Resource-Constrained Space Robotics with Criticality Analysis

author.name: Siddhant Shete, Hilmi Dogu K\"uc\"uker, Udo Frese, Frank Kirchner

entry.summary: Presents a deployment oriented instance segmentation stack for lunar robotics under low light, limited compute, and radiation faults. Introduces label free AVIS calibration via activation variance and deploys YOLO based model on DPU with architectural tweaks. Jointly studies quantization and fault exposure.

entry.title: Cite or Decline: A Strict Course-Grounded Chatbot for STEM Lecture Videos

author.name: S M Masrur Ahmed, Jaspal Subhlok

entry.summary: Reports semester long deployment of VideoPoints RAG chatbot that answers only from active course lectures with timestamped citations. Across 833 messages most answers cited sources, none crossed course boundaries, and it declined when evidence was missing. Supports exam review and lookup trust.

entry.title: Predictors of Loneliness in Older Adults Using Multimodal Analysis of Speech and Language

author.name: Vinmay Khandode, Sai Karthik Kosuri, Neil K. R. Sehgal, Adam Greene, Elif Alpoge, Elana Duffy, Matthew Lee Smith, Thomas K. M. Cudjoe, Sharath Chandra Guntuku

entry.summary: Analyzes speech and language markers of loneliness in 310 older adults from semi structured phone interviews. Combines psycholinguistic, n gram, topic, and acoustic pitch and loudness features against self reported scores. Supports scalable objective detection in natural conversation.

entry.title: Cross-Model Distillation of a Human-Pose Foundation Model from Unannotated Infant Video for Markerless 3D Pose Estimation

author.name: R. James Cotton, Divya Joshi, Colleen Peyton

entry.summary: Distills a human-pose foundation model using unannotated infant video to improve markerless 3D infant pose for neuromotor screening. Combines strengths of models that separately excel at 2D keypoints and 3D recovery. Targets early cerebral palsy risk assessment without markers.

entry.title: LookStep: Efficient Vision-Language Navigation with Linguistic Foresight and Event Driven Memory

author.name: Kun-Yang Yu, Yingzhe Li, Hongyu Xu, Shi-Yu Tian, Zhi Zhou, Yang Chen, Ming Yang, Sheng Wang, Qing Yu, Lan-Zhe Guo, Yu-Feng Li

entry.summary: Proposes LookStep for resource-efficient vision-language navigation combining linguistic foresight of future states with event-driven rolling memory. Replaces heavy maps and frame stacks with language-centric modeling supervised beyond next-step action. Reduces data and memory overhead.

entry.title: MARS: What Retrieval Signals Are Hidden in Multimodal Large Language Models for Text-Video Retrieval?

author.name: Uicheol Jung, Juyoung Hong, Geuntaek Lim, Yukyung Choi

entry.summary: Proposes MARS, a multi-layer multi-slot embedding framework that pools diverse hidden states from MLLMs for text-video retrieval. Compares corresponding slots to preserve fine-grained cues lost in single-token pooling. Improves discrimination of similar scenes and actions.

entry.title: Generating Medical Image Counterfactuals using Causal Explanations

author.name: David A. Kelly, Tom Yaacov, Nathan Blake, Sander Beckers, Hana Chockler

entry.summary: Proposes classifier-grounded causal counterfactuals for medical images without auxiliary GAN or diffusion generators. Separates classifier logic from generator bias to audit decisions. Improves explainability for clinical deployment.

entry.title: GDB-Reward: From Evaluation Metrics to Training Rewards for Graphic Design

author.name: Adrienne Deganutti, Purvanshi Mehta, Simon Hadfield, Andrew Gilbert

entry.summary: Proposes GDB-Reward that reuses graphic design evaluation metrics on typography, layout and color as RL rewards for prompt optimization of frozen text-to-image models. Avoids costly diffusion fine-tuning. Explores non-differentiable design alignment.

entry.title: LLM-Driven Joint Evolution of Coupled Heuristics Components for Routing Optimization

author.name: Juntao Wei, Yangming Zhou, Zhibin Jiang, Shan Jiang

entry.summary: Proposes LLM-HCJG population framework that jointly generates initialization and penalty heuristics for guided local search under shared blueprint. Couples interdependent components and transfers TSP forms to routing. Moves beyond isolated component evolution.

entry.title: Design and Validation of a Lightweight, Low-Profile Powered Knee Prosthesis with Quasi-Direct Drive Actuation

author.name: Ross J. Cortino, Ryan Posh, Emily G. Keller, Robert D. Gregg

entry.summary: Designs and validates a 2.6kg 24.5cm quasi-direct-drive powered knee with 18 to 1 two-stage transmission plus thermal-structural optimization. Improves torque control, backdrivability and noise over highly geared knees while cutting bulk. Human-subject validation.

entry.title: ClaimReceipt: Verifying Evidence Sufficiency and Coverage in Agent Evaluations

author.name: Peiying Zhu, Sidi Chang

entry.summary: Proposes ClaimReceipt, a claim-relative receipt spec that binds typed evidence to a signed experiment manifest and verifies sufficiency and coverage as pass, invalid, or inconclusive. Demonstrated by replaying historical buyer-seller records and audit verdicts.

entry.title: SCX Router: Streaming Zero-Shot Model Selection with a Decoder-KV Classifier and a Real-World Task Ontology

author.name: Ihor Stepanov, Aleksandr Smechov, Mykhailo Shtopko, Dmytro Vodianytskyi, Oleksandr Lukashov

entry.summary: Introduces a lightweight 0.6B router that scores suitability of inference models per task without autoregressive generation, using a task ontology to balance speed, cost, and quality. Targets heterogeneous endpoints with varying expertise and latency.

entry.title: Modeling What Changes: Sparse, Residual World Models for Object-Centric Manipulation

author.name: Param Thakkar, Parsika Paresh Shah, Manisha Sushant Gote

entry.summary: Proposes sparse residual world models that predict only per object changes via a change gate plus delta head. Achieves large accuracy and parameter gains on MuJoCo pushing and zero shot transfer across object counts.

entry.title: OmegaUse-SOP: SOP Engineering for Professional Computer Use from Human Demonstrations

author.name: Yixiong Xiao, Lang An, Hucheng Yang, Pinxue Ma, Yongquan Chen, Jingjia Cao, Yusai Zhao, Ting Wang, Ting Liu, Siqi Bao, Jingbo Zhou, Hua Wu

entry.summary: Introduces OmegaUse-SOP, a human in the loop system that turns professional computer use demonstrations into executable SOPs with verification. Targets domain specific GUI agent failures from implicit knowledge and conventions.

entry.title: Competitive Market Behavior of LLMs

author.name: Pawel Struski, Jakub Swistak, Inez Okulska, Przemyslaw Biecek

entry.summary: Places LLM agents in double auction markets replicating classic human experiments to test allocative efficiency. Finds slower or degraded convergence, probing compatibility of LLM agents with human designed mechanisms.

category.term: Interpretability Culture and Human Centered Evaluation

entry.title: Generative Diffusion Surrogates with Analytical Variance Schedule

author.name: Patrick Reichherzer, Gianluca Gregori, David N. Hosking, Subir Sarkar

entry.summary: Proposes diffusion surrogates for stochastic transport where variance schedule is set analytically from physics rather than heuristically. Aims for probabilistic, time-resolved surrogates that respect known mean-square displacement. Connects generative modeling to physical clocks.

entry.title: DMRL: Document-Mediated Reinforcement Learning for Skill Optimization in Advertising Recommendation

author.name: Wei Zhang, Hongji Li, Song Sun, Peng Yu, Xue Yang, Lei Zhao, Peng Jiang

entry.summary: Introduces Document-Mediated RL where an upper agent edits skill documents and a frozen lower agent is evaluated via A/B testing to attribute reward to edits. Applied to advertising recommendation tuning balancing revenue and experience. Formalizes prompt-doc evolution as RL.

category.term: Agents, Reinforcement Learning and Test-Time Compute

entry.title: H3DNAS: Hardware-Aware ONNX-Native 3D Point Cloud Model Compression

author.name: Anchit Mulye, Rhythm Baghel, Sujay Kumar Ingle, Hardik Jain

entry.summary: Introduces H3DNAS, hardware-aware compression operating directly on ONNX graphs for 3D point clouds on Jetson Orin Nano without source or gradients. Uses channel dependency graph to guide search. Enables vendor-binary optimization for edge.

entry.title: Linear Fusion MultiDiffusion for Fast Training-Free Spherical Panorama Generation

author.name: Akio Hayakawa, Yusuke Mukuta, Tatsuya Harada

entry.summary: Proposes LF-MultiDiffusion, a training free method for spherical panorama generation that reformulates latent aggregation as regularized least squares. Uses a Krylov solver inside denoising to support denser linear mappings with far fewer views. Reports better quality, text alignment, and fewer generator evaluations.

entry.title: GenCAR: Generative Counterfactual Alignment with Risk-Controlled Selection for Out-of-Distribution Recommendation

author.name: Qianqian Wang, Yunshan Li, Jiawen Zeng, Wenwu Gong, Lili Yang

entry.summary: Formulates out of distribution recommendation as valid counterfactual serving with false discovery control on proxy labels. Proposes GenCAR coupling preference grounded counterfactual supervision with calibrated set selection. Aims to balance utility and risk when serving under shift.

entry.title: GRADSOLVE: fast exact gradients for ODE ensembles on GPUs

author.name: Alessio Spurio Mancini

entry.summary: Presents GRADSOLVE, an open source JAX library for solving and reverse mode differentiating low dimensional ODE ensembles on NVIDIA GPUs. Records accepted adaptive steps to differentiate at fused kernel solve speed. Removes tradeoff between fast ensembles and differentiable solvers.

entry.title: Grounded, Compute-Efficient LLM Policy Agents for Energy-Poverty Equity in Physically-Constrained Peer-to-Peer Energy Markets

author.name: Kunal Jadhav, Siddhesh More

entry.summary: Presents EqGrid, a closed loop simulation where a low frequency open weight LLM sets price and subsidy bounds while RL traders clear a peer to peer market under IEEE 33 bus physics. Uses grounded household personas to study energy poverty equity. Tackles computational irony of cloud LLMs for humanitarian settings.

entry.title: How LLMs Build Fictional Worlds: Setting and Narrative Space in AI-Generated Creative Storytelling

author.name: Katrin Rohrbacher, Bj\"orn Nieth, Emmanuelle Salin, Bjoern Eskofier, Michaela Mahlberg

entry.summary: Analyzes worldbuilding in 1,000 stories per existing model in English and German versus Project Gutenberg human fiction. Operationalizes setting via BERT classifiers for action, perceived, visual, descriptive, and no space categories. Finds humans ground more in action space than current models.

entry.title: Privacy Washing: Detecting Internal Contradictions in Privacy Policies

author.name: Thomas Brackin

entry.summary: Defines privacy washing as internal contradictions where privacy policies undermine their own commitments, especially around third-party sharing. Builds a four-stage extraction and multi-model judge pipeline and applies it to 2026 and 2015 corpora. Finds persistent patterns over 11 years.

entry.title: Allocate Before You Embed: Adaptive Visual Input Allocation for Video Embeddings

author.name: Song Jin, Zhongtao Jiang, Chenglei Shen, Huanxuan Liao, Haozhe Chi, Zhiwei Wang, Kun Xu, Yong Liu

entry.summary: Proposes AllocEmbed, an allocate-then-embed framework that reallocates fixed visual-input budgets across more video frames using low-cost previews. Preserves resolution where it matters while expanding temporal coverage for retrieval. Shows coverage plus fidelity both improve recall.

entry.title: TempoGround: State-Aware Streaming Visual Grounding with Vision-Language Models

author.name: Leqian Ding, Junning Qiu, Manwen Yang, Yu Guo, Fei Wang

entry.summary: Presents TempoGround, a vision-language framework for streaming visual grounding that models cross-frame correspondence and explicit object presence states. Uses curriculum prediction to maintain identity consistency under occlusion and drift. Targets open-vocabulary perception in video streams.

entry.title: AffectDelta: Beyond Emotion Labels for Image Editing

author.name: Xingzu Zhan, Lin Gu, Ruogu Fang

entry.summary: Presents AffectDelta for emotion-driven editing as transition between eight-dimensional emotion distributions rather than single labels. Uses frozen emotion predictor to guide source-aware changes while preserving composition. Enables nuanced increase and decrease of coexisting emotions.

entry.title: Efficient All-in-One Weather Restoration using Spectral Harmonization

author.name: Paula Garrido-Mellado, Daniel Feijoo, Yuning Cui, Alvaro Garcia, Marcos V. Conde

entry.summary: Presents FReSH-IR, a lightweight all-in-one weather restorer decomposing features into high and low frequencies at each encoder-decoder scale with Fourier skips. Captures complementary spectral cues without heavy compute. Targets high-resolution physical AI.

entry.title: Designing Versatile Samples for Learned Trajectory Scoring

author.name: Yaguang Li, Jiaru Zhang, Chuheng Wei, Can Cui, Ziran Wang

entry.summary: Designs lateral-to-boundary and longitudinal-to-leader perturbations of human trajectories to train learned trajectory scorers for end-to-end driving. Provides decision-boundary supervision missing from mode-collapsed planner proposals. Keeps planner frozen while improving selection.

entry.title: Semantics-Guided Automatic Tensorization for Multiobjective Evolutionary Algorithms: A Multi-Agent Framework

author.name: Zhenyu Liang, Beichen Huang, Bowen Zheng, Ran Cheng

entry.summary: Formulates automatic tensorization of multiobjective evolutionary algorithms as semantics-preserving restructuring and builds EvoCoCo multi-agent converter. Rebuilds states, dependencies and operators for tensor platforms without changing optimization logic. Accelerates mature CPU codes.

entry.title: What is neuralese and why is it bad?

author.name: Linch

entry.summary: Explains chain-of-thought as natural-language recurrence that extends reasoning and provides an incidental monitorability benefit. Defines neuralese as a shift to opaque latent recurrence where intermediate thought is no longer human-readable, arguing this is bad for safety. Matters because it frames current debate around recurrent models and hidden reasoning.

entry.title: Propose to Learn, Learn to Propose: Evaluability-Aware Assistance under Bounded Rationality

author.name: Yifan Zhu, Sammie Katt, Samuel Kaski

entry.summary: Formalizes ProSE, a sequential assistance setting where AI proposals both help the task and probe latent user preferences under bounded-rational evaluability constraints. Uses a KL-regularized response model balancing value and evaluation cost.

entry.title: Federated LoRA Adaptation of BiomedCLIP Across Four International Chest X-Ray Cohorts

author.name: Sanjaya Poudel, Nirajan Kunwor, Manish Dhakal, Debesh Jha, Sunil Kumar Gaire

entry.summary: Benchmarks federated LoRA fine tuning of BiomedCLIP for chest X-ray classification across four cohorts on three continents. Compares aggregation strategies under scanner and protocol heterogeneity without sharing data.

entry.title: CrashDiffuser: VLM-Guided Collision Intent Reasoning for Fine-Grained Safety-Critical Traffic Scenario Generation

author.name: Shucheng Zhang, Yuang Zhang, Bingzhang Wang, Muhammad Monjurul Karim, Kehua Chen, Yinhai Wang

entry.summary: Introduces CrashDiffuser for fine grained safety critical driving scenarios requiring specific head, rear or side contact. Decouples VLM collision intent reasoning from diffusion trajectory synthesis in closed loop replanning.

entry.title: ViSAR: Training-Free Adaptive-$k$ Retrieval for Visual Document Question Answering

author.name: Adrien Mialland, Marc Plantevit, Julien Gallois, C\'eline Robardet

entry.summary: Introduces ViSAR, a training free adaptive k retriever for visual document QA operating in late interaction embedding space. Selects pages per query complexity to cut LVLM latency and preserve accuracy.

entry.title: Sim2Signal: Sim-to-Real Benchmarks for Traffic Signal Control

author.name: Ferdous Al Rafi, Susrik Mukherjee, Latika Liladhar Dekate, Jennifer Yawa Lavoe, Huaiyuan Yao, Shlok Mohanty, Longchao Da, Xuesong Zhou, Hua Wei

entry.summary: Introduces Sim2Signal, a benchmark decomposing traffic signal sim-to-real gap into observation, action, transition and reward mismatches. Evaluates mitigation methods systematically for RL signal control. Helps explain why sim-trained policies fail in deployment.

entry.title: DynG-Diff: A State-Aware Dynamic Guidance Diffusion Framework for Probabilistic Time Series Forecasting

author.name: Zhente Zhang, Zhengwei Ni, Wei Fan

entry.summary: Proposes DynG-Diff, a two-stage diffusion forecaster with unconditional joint backbone plus lightweight state-aware guidance to handle heterogeneous noise across variables. Targets probabilistic multivariate time series. Aims for flexible conditioning without task-specific design.

entry.title: Differentiable Electricity-Market Clearing for Gradient-Based Planning

author.name: Luca Mungo, Maarten P. Scholl, Arnau Quera-Bofarull

entry.summary: Treats electricity market clearing as differentiable optimization layer to get gradients from planning cost through cleared prices to data-center siting decisions. Validates against finite differences and demos 50 MW allocation. Enables gradient-based infrastructure planning.

entry.title: Reinforcement learning to choose optimizers

author.name: Martin van der Schelling, Deepesh Toshniwal, Miguel A. Bessa

entry.summary: Formulates optimizer selection during training as sequential decision making with a recurrent policy. At each step it chooses both which optimizer to use and for how long from gradient based and other portfolios. Matters for automating a choice that currently relies on heuristics and fixed schedules.

entry.title: Scalable Direction-Following TTS via Voice Impression-Guided Pseudo Triplet Construction

author.name: Kenichi Fujita, Yusuke Ijima

entry.summary: Addresses direction following TTS where delivery must change per textual direction while preserving speaker and content. Builds scalable pseudo triplets using impression controllable synthesis plus LLM generated directions from impression differences. Enables training without scarce paired direction data.

entry.title: Improving Health Literacy through Lay Summarization of Radiological Reports: An Evaluation of BioNER and Retrieval-Augmented Generation

author.name: Egecan \c{C}elik Evgin, \.Ilknur Karadeniz, Olcay Taner Y{\i}ld{\i}z

entry.summary: Tests whether retrieval augmentation and biomedical NER improve lay summarization of radiology reports for patients. Targets readability and factual consistency versus direct LLM explanation risks. Addresses underexplored clinically informed generation for health literacy.

entry.title: Evidence-Guided Detection, Localization and Explanation for Text-Centric Image Forensics

author.name: Peifeng Liu, Bin Li, Qingsong Zhang, Yangxin Yu, Leqing Chen, Xiaoye Qiu

entry.summary: Builds a detector-localizer-reasoner system for text-centric image forensics that cascades global authenticity, tampered region grounding and model-generated reports. Designed for AI-generated text manipulation challenges. Emphasizes evidence-grounded explanations.

entry.title: From Detection to Localization: A Unified Forensics Framework for Fully Synthetic and Tampered Images

author.name: Annalisa Gallina, Marco Fiorucci, Marco Brigo, Federica Battisti, Lamberto Ballan

entry.summary: Extends forgery detection to unified multiclass real versus fully generated versus tampered with pixel-level localization branch. Moves beyond binary real-fake classification. Improves interpretability for mixed manipulations.

entry.title: Benchmarking RAW and RGB Restoration in Image Signal Processors

author.name: Zihao Lu, Radu Timofte, Marcos V. Conde

entry.summary: Benchmarks blind restoration before ISP in RAW versus after ISP in sRGB across phones, learned ISPs and noise-blur regimes. Finds placement alone does not decide, but ISP-aware RGB training wins overall while RAW beats generic RGB. Guides camera pipeline design.

entry.title: Data-Efficient Networks for Multi-Contrast MRI Reconstruction based on a Generalized Content/Style Prior

author.name: Chinmay Rao, Efe Il{\i}cak, Matthias J. P. van Osch, Mariya Doneva, Laurens Beljaards, Navid Jabarimani, Nicola Pezzotti, Marius Staring

entry.summary: Proposes CoSMo-RecNet modular content-style representation learned from unpaired public images to enable guided multi-contrast MRI reconstruction in low-data regimes. Reuses structural redundancy across contrasts. Reduces need for large paired raw datasets.

entry.title: Koopman-Based Robust Model Predictive Control for Nonlinear Systems with Stochastic Intermittent Measurements

author.name: Guanhua Liu, Tong Wu, Lixian Zhang, Weifeng Du, Minghao Han

entry.summary: Develops Koopman Lipschitz deep latent predictor with probabilistically truncated soft constraints for stochastic MPC under intermittent measurements. Models outages as Markov chain yielding jump error model for stability and feasibility. Targets constrained nonlinear systems.

entry.title: If you're interpreting <1B parameter models, you should use a tensor transformer

author.name: Logan Riggs

entry.summary: Advises interpretability researchers on sub-1B models to use bilinear tensor transformers to exploit linear algebra and remove functionally irrelevant symmetries via generalized cosine similarity. Notes similarity between SwiGLU used in existing architectures like DeepSeek-V3, Kimi K2, and Qwen and the bilinear form, plus shared lack of global Lipschitz properties. Technical methods note for small-model science.

entry.title: The Ceiling Is in the Channel: Auditing Learner Gaps and Measurement Frontiers in Clinical Prediction

author.name: Sayeed Shafayet Chowdhury, Nusrat Jahan, Snehasis Mukhopadhyay, Shiaofen Fang, Vijay R. Ramakrishnan

entry.summary: Distinguishes learner gap from measurement-channel ceiling in clinical prediction, characterizing optimal accuracy via distributional separation and providing estimators and diagnostics. Validated on readmission, diabetes, and related cohorts.

entry.title: Two Centuries of Sexism in British Parliament: A Computational Analysis of Women's Representation in the Hansard Corpus

author.name: Mohammad Omar Khursheed, Mandira Sawkar, Ashiqur R. KhudaBukhsh

entry.summary: Analyzes 6,531 speeches across two centuries of Hansard debates on womens representation using LLMs and an ambivalent sexism lens. Releases an enriched corpus of 6.7 million speeches with metadata and gender matching.

entry.title: OutageDiT: A Generative Foundation Model for Power Outage Forecasting and Scenario Simulation

author.name: Yunqin Zhu, Feng Qiu, Yao Xie

entry.summary: Introduces OutageDiT, a generative foundation model for seven day power outage trajectories at quarter hour resolution trained on US outage and weather data. Uses condition encoder plus shallow flow decoder to preserve temporal dependence under rare extremes.

entry.title: OBJECTION! Lawyer Agents Mitigate Guilty Bias in Legal Judgment Prediction

author.name: Jaehoon Jeong, Jay-Yoon Lee

entry.summary: Introduces OBJECTION, an inference time adversarial lawyer agent that challenges prosecution narrative inside offense, unlawfulness and culpability reasoning. Aims to reduce guilty bias from imbalanced LJP data.

category.term: Interpretability Culture and Human Centered Evaluation

entry.title: DiffIE: Diffusion-based Open Information Extraction

author.name: Konstantin Fedorov, Valentin Malykh

entry.summary: Treats OpenIE as multi output problem solved by conditional discrete diffusion over role tags. Independent reverse trajectories create candidate triplets that are clustered and ranked with inference time control of budget.

entry.title: NE-R1: Enhancing Named Entity Recognition Model via Reinforcement Learning

author.name: Meixuan Chen, Hehan Li, Ruizhi Zhao, Xin Lu, peizhi xu, Liwei Qian, LI Meifang, shuanglong li, Hanmeng Liu, Xin Pei, Yanbiao Ma

entry.summary: Proposes NE-R1 with retrieval on demand for NER, using multitask tuning plus end to end RL with chain of thought to decide when external knowledge is needed. Reduces noise and cost on familiar entities while helping long tail.

entry.title: frb100-40 After Two Decades: An Optimality Certificate and a Preregistered Search Study

author.name: Onur U\u{g}urlu (\.Izmir Bak{\i}r\c{c}ay University)

entry.summary: Claims resolution of the 20-year Model-RB frb100-40 challenge by providing a checkable 100-vertex independent set plus clique partition certificate. Separately runs a preregistered study finding no acceleration from added repair operators. Contribution is the optimality proof, not the negative search result.

entry.title: Median-of-Means as an Extremal Convex Estimator and a Nonconvex Route to the Trimmed Oracle

author.name: Angshul Majumdar

entry.summary: Analyzes median-of-means from optimization view, proving convex block estimators cannot reach trimmed-oracle robustness and proposing nonconvex block-Lp family with finite-sample bounds. Theoretical advance for heavy-tailed and corrupted data. Relevant to robust learning foundations.

entry.title: TrajMind: Chaining Role-Specialized LoRAs for Fast-and-Slow Collective Trajectory Anomaly Diagnosis

author.name: Jiahao Wu, Zhenqun Yang, Chen Jason Zhang, Qing Li

entry.summary: Proposes TrajMind which chains role-specialized LoRAs for fast screening plus on-demand verified diagnosis of collective trajectory anomalies. Separates always-on alerts from source-verified what-who-where-when records. Balances latency and verifiability for traffic governance.

entry.title: Pooling and Drift in Delayed Bandits

author.name: Melika Baghi

entry.summary: Studies bandits with delayed feedback where outcomes depend on state rather than action identity. Proves regret scaling with effective dimension of states rather than number of actions. Matters for recommenders and systems where clicks are fast but conversions are slow.

entry.title: Perceptually Regularized Diffusion Model for Image Super-Resolution

author.name: Chuxiangbo Wang, Pavithra Venkatachalapathy, Ying Liang, Min Wang, Jing Qin, Yifei Lou, Weihong Guo

entry.summary: Adds perceptual regularization to diffusion based image super resolution beyond pixel level denoising loss. Aims to improve perceptual quality for medical, remote sensing, and microscopy uses. Represents a refinement to established diffusion SR training rather than a new paradigm.

entry.title: RideSkill: A Hierarchical Algorithm for Generalized Ride Sharing with LLM-Driven Automatic Evolution

author.name: Zijian Zhao, Sen Li, Xialiang Tong, Mingxuan Yuan

entry.summary: Proposes RideSkill, a hierarchical approach for generalized ride sharing with LLM driven automatic evolution to address generalization and transfer limits of MARL. Targets bundling of diverse origin destination orders under uncertainty and varying platform objectives. Aims to ease curse of dimensionality in large fleets.

entry.title: Learning-Based Reconstruction Attacks on Coordinate-Obfuscated Point Clouds

author.name: Mohammad Waquas Usmani, Susmit Shannigrahi, Michael Zink

entry.summary: Evaluates selective coordinate encryption for point cloud volumetric video against ML reconstruction attacks. Tests whether remaining unencrypted geometry suffices to recover content and defeat visual degradation. Questions cost saving encryption that leaves structural cues.

entry.title: Learning Spectral-Like Mesh-Free Discretisations

author.name: Lucas Gerken Starepravo, Henry Broadley, Steven Lind, Jack R. C. King

entry.summary: Learns mesh free discretizations that improve fine scale accuracy beyond polynomial consistency used in SPH, RBF-FD, and LABFM. Notes underdetermined stencils leave degrees of freedom fixed implicitly by kernels or minimum norm. Targets spectral like behavior at higher wavenumbers.

entry.title: A Tri-Agent Framework for Evaluating and Aligning Question Clarification Capabilities of Large Language Models

author.name: Yikai Zhao, Saurabh Pandey, Pradeep Kumar Misra

entry.summary: Proposes a tri agent framework with clarifying agent, simulated respondent, and evaluator to test handling of ambiguous queries. Focuses on identifying ambiguity and asking effective clarifications under challenging replies. Standardizes interactive intent understanding evaluation.

entry.title: PragAlign: Feedback-Guided Pragmatic Alignment for Controlled Synthetic Dialogue Generation

author.name: Smitha Muthya Sudheendra, Jaideep Srivastava

entry.summary: Introduces PragAlign, a generate evaluate revise loop for synthetic dialogues conditioned on intent, emotion, and style with up to three refinements. Reports near perfect evaluator acceptance on 800 specifications for privacy restricted service settings. Heavy reliance on LLM evaluator scores.

entry.title: DiscoSign: Discourse-Aware Text to Sign Language Gloss Translation

author.name: Vasileios Baltatzis, Mert Inan, Connor Gillis, Raja Kushalnagar, Lorna Quandt, Leah Findlater, Colin Lea

entry.summary: Proposes DiscoSign, a modular LLM framework for text to sign gloss translation that models discourse phenomena. Handles spatial coreference, question-answer clauses and concept-to-sign consistency beyond sentence level. Advances linguistic grounding for accessible sign language systems.

entry.title: Beyond Textual Chain-of-Thought: A Survey on Action-Grounded Reasoning in Autonomous Driving

author.name: Zhengxu Tang, Xiaozhou Zhang, Guofeng Cui, Ziyu Gong, Zi Wang, Yunfei Shi, Ruifeng Deng, Chengzhi Qi, Ke Chen, Sachin Patil, Tianjun Xiao, Langechuan Liu, Pichao Wang

entry.summary: Surveys 171 papers on shifting from textual chain-of-thought to action-grounded reasoning for autonomous driving. Organizes methods by intermediate representation into language, visual-spatial, latent-dynamic and externalized types. Provides taxonomy for linking reasoning structure to continuous driving actions.

entry.title: DPA: Decoupling Product-Agnostic Anomaly Representations for Zero-shot Anomaly Generation

author.name: Hang Yao, Yansheng Fu, Ming Liu, Zifei Yan, Yanli Ji, Hongzhi Zhang, Wangmeng Zuo

entry.summary: Proposes anomaly transfer for zero-shot industrial anomaly generation by reusing real anomalies from source products and decoupling product-agnostic representations. Avoids unrealistic texture or text-prompted defects for unseen products. Supports detection with only normal images.

entry.title: Uncertainty-Guided Adverse Weather Restoration via Gated Transformer Network

author.name: Zheke Jin, Yuning Cui, Tianle Jin, Alois Knoll, Hu Cao

entry.summary: Proposes UAR-Net, an all-in-one adverse weather restorer with gated dual-scale transformer blocks, balanced multi-scale skips and uncertainty guidance. It targets spatially heterogeneous rain, haze and snow degradations better than weather-agnostic global fusion. Useful for robust outdoor vision but architecturally incremental.

entry.title: Multi-Tool Image Editing Attribution in Facial Forgery

author.name: Sheng Liu, Qiang Sheng, Danding Wang, Yu Li, Chenming Zhou, Juan Cao

entry.summary: Defines multi-tool image editing attribution for facial forgeries where artifacts from several tools overlap. Builds simulated multi-tool data and model to identify all involved editors. Extends beyond single-tool attribution assumption.

entry.title: MuyBridge: Mobile Human Center-of-Mass Estimation from Monocular Video via Sparse Fusion

author.name: Aidan Bradshaw, Marco Giordano, David Rode, Andreas Habersack, Elif Basokur, Annika Kruse, Markus Tilp, Michele Magno, Peter Wolf, Luca Benini, Christoph Leitner

entry.summary: Introduces MuyBridge, an on-device system estimating 3D center-of-mass trajectory from single phone video via compact pose net and distilled fusion. Targets coaches with metric biomechanics where labs are unavailable. Focuses on sport and rehab deployment.

entry.title: Efficient Passive Acoustic Monitoring of Killer Whales Using a Two-Stage Detection and Ecotype Classification Cascade

author.name: Daniela Ruiz, Manuel Castellote, Zhongqi Miao, Carl Chalmers, Bruno Demuro, Rahul Dodhia, Pablo Arbelaez, Juan M. Lavista

entry.summary: Proposes lightweight ResNet two-stage cascade for killer whale detection then five-ecotype classification with abstention on ambiguous calls. Achieves 0.96 macro-F1 on DCLDE 2027 beating frozen embeddings. Enables real-time conservation monitoring under imbalance.

entry.title: SALA: Semantic-Aware Logical Alignment for Complex Reasoning in In-Context Learning

author.name: Zhao Ji, Wenqing Chen, Zhixuan Chu, Jianxing Yu, Jingping Liu, Shanhe Zhao, Zibin Zheng

entry.summary: Proposes SALA for demonstration selection in complex reasoning, automatically discovering task-specific operations and aligning reasoning sequences in semantic space with dynamic time warping. Avoids rigid predefined steps and exact matching.

entry.title: WMLLM: Self-Evolving Optimization Agents via Predict-Then-Act World Modeling

author.name: Zhongzheng Li, Qingsong Ran, Shikun Feng, Nian Ran, Wenhao Li, Xiaoyuan Zhang, Yue Wang, Xiaoguang Zhao

entry.summary: Proposes WMLLM, a self-evolving optimization agent that first predicts promising search directions with LLM world knowledge before costly black-box evaluations, then acts to generate candidates. Targets sample efficiency in high-dimensional spaces.

entry.title: MeanField Surrogate Modeling for Scalable Runtime Scheduling of Concurrent Heterogeneous AI Inference on Shared GPUs

author.name: Youssef Ennouri, Soonhoi Ha

entry.summary: Proposes MeanField surrogate that predicts per model performance from local config plus aggregate GPU state for concurrent heterogeneous inference. Achieves high accuracy with linear sample growth instead of combinatorial profiling.

entry.title: DiffuSearch: How Hybrid Trajectory Planning Benefits from Aligned Objectives in Diffusion and Action Space

author.name: Steffen Hagedorn, Aron Distelzweig, Alexandru P. Condurache

entry.summary: Presents DiffuSearch, a hybrid planner that aligns objectives across diffusion generation and refinement for autonomous driving. Enforces shared goals of collision avoidance, drivable compliance, comfort and progress.

entry.title: Automated Vulnerability Injection in Smart Contracts Using Large Language Models

author.name: Luca Migliaccio, Roberto Natella, Naghmeh Ivaki, Nuno Laranjeiro, Marco Vieira

entry.summary: Uses LLMs to inject 49 OpenSCV vulnerability types into Solidity contracts with multistep validation for compilation, execution and logic. Yields 32 confirmed cases spanning 25 types from nearly 1000 candidates.

entry.title: Exact Limits of Random Projections for Preserving Geometry: Distance Recovery, Nearest-Neighbor Rankings, and Covariance Shape in Gaussian Models

author.name: Piyush Sao

entry.summary: Shows Johnson-Lindenstrauss guarantees can be satisfied even by independent data, then derives exact limits for recovering distances, rankings and covariance shape from random projections under Gaussian models. Clarifies what geometry sketches preserve. Foundational sketching insight.

entry.title: Do Cantonese-Adapted Language Models Better Predict Cantonese Reading? A Cross-Model Eye-Tracking Evaluation

author.name: Ziqi Zhang, Emmanuele Chersoni, Mohammad Momenian

entry.summary: Compares Cantonese adapted versus base models on predicting naturalistic Cantonese reading eye movements. Contrasts light adaptation of GPT-2 Tiny and heavier continued pretraining of Qwen 7B scale models. Questions whether variety specific training improves psycholinguistic alignment.

entry.title: DESA-TTA: Dynamic EMA and Source Anchoring for Test-Time Adaptation

author.name: Atif Belal, Lilian Hollard, Marco Pedersoli, Eric Granger

entry.summary: Proposes DESA-TTA for test-time adaptation of vision-language detectors using dynamic teacher averaging and source anchoring. Estimates teacher reliability to adjust updates and curbs student drift from noisy pseudo-labels. Low-overhead robustness fix for deployment shifts.

entry.title: Lightweight Adaptation of General-Purpose VLMs for Multispectral and SAR Image Understanding

author.name: Shanji Liu, Kelu Yao, Junxiao Xue, Chenghui Lv, Xiangyang Miao, Yekai Huang, Yaying Chen, Chao Li

entry.summary: Shows general vision-language models can handle multispectral and SAR imagery via multi-image prompting without dedicated encoders. Renders observations as optical and SAR views with named prompts and light adaptation. Offers lightweight reuse of strong checkpoints for remote sensing.

entry.title: T2LSC-Bench: Benchmarking Localized Semantic Control in Text-to-Image Generation

author.name: Yan Wang, Xinyi Hou, Weiguo Lin, Junjun Si, Siwei Ma

entry.summary: Introduces T2LSC-Bench to measure localized semantic control in text-to-image models, where target text must appear only in designated regions without leaking into scene content. Goes beyond spelling accuracy to test subject and scene preservation for labeling and signage. Exposes leakage failures.

entry.title: Post-Training Ternarization of Qwen3-4B Capability, Effective Bit Budget, Storage Compression, and Deployment

author.name: Anirudh Malik, M Sparsh Mehra, Poojith Devan

entry.summary: Reports end-to-end post-training ternarization of an existing instruction-tuned Qwen3 4B model using rotation, ternarization, and error compensation, reaching about 1.64 effective bits for quantized weights. Analyzes capability retention, perplexity, calibration, and deployment behavior.

entry.title: Beyond Context Windows: Persistent Discovery Context for Data-Centric Agents

author.name: Jalal Mahmud

entry.summary: Proposes persistent discovery context, a lightweight memory of prior intent-to-object mappings to augment retrieval for data-centric agents. Shows gains over metadata-only search and documents an interference failure mode.

entry.title: Task-Level Natural Language Priors as Learning Signals for Low-Resource LLM Training

author.name: Jian Gao, Xiao Zhang, Xun Zhu, Miao Li, Ji Wu

entry.summary: Treats task-level natural language priors as auxiliary training signals rather than just input context for low-resource tuning. Introduces Contrastive Prior Steering with positive and negative prior-conditioned losses alongside supervision.

entry.title: Loom: Weaving Diagnostic Strands into Free-Text Consensus via Embedding-Space Reweighting

author.name: Ron Begleiter, Katya Egert Berg, Gilad Saban, Gil Shabat

entry.summary: Presents Loom, a generative consensus framework for root cause analysis that aggregates open-form hypotheses from modular heuristics via embedding-space reweighting. Deployed industrially to balance expressivity with statistical rigor and latency.

entry.title: RecKAN: Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks with a Learnable Recursive Polynomial Basis

author.name: Amirhosein Azarpour

entry.summary: Introduces RecKAN, which learns the polynomial recurrence defining the basis functions in Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks rather than fixing splines or Chebyshev forms. Shows it recovers classical families and proves expressivity properties.

entry.title: Import What You Need: Learning When and How to Augment EHR Graphs with External Knowledge

author.name: Chen Chen, Mohsen Nayebi Kerdabadi, Dongjie Wang, Mei Liu, Zijun Yao

entry.summary: Proposes ReTA, a reinforcement learning policy that dynamically selects knowledge graph augmentation per clinical visit under a budget. Improves longitudinal EHR prediction over static context agnostic augmentation.

entry.title: Convergence Theory of Knowledge Distillation in Asynchronous P2P Gossip Learning Network

author.name: Lucas Qingyang Fang, Tiyao Liu, Jinhao Jing, Zeji Li, Kaijie Chen, Harikrishna Kuttivelil, Katia Obraczka

entry.summary: Provides convergence theory for asynchronous peer to peer knowledge distillation where heterogeneous models cannot average weights. Frames KD as contraction in prediction space under smoothness and realizability assumptions.

entry.title: Signal or Noise? Auditing Rotation-Induced Saliency Drift in Medical and Aerial Imaging

author.name: Khawaja Murad ul Hassan, Mehran Ebrahimi

entry.summary: Audits why Grad-CAM saliency drifts under rotation even when predictions stay stable in histopathology and aerial imaging. Finds channel weights are stable and instability comes from later CAM operator stages.

category.term: Interpretability Culture and Human Centered Evaluation

entry.title: What Is Worth Representing? Representational Empowerment for Continual Model Construction

author.name: Fei Dai, Hanqi Zhou, Alison Gopnik, Charley Wu

entry.summary: Frames world modeling as deciding what to represent, proposing Representational Empowerment to score elements by future modeling capacity. Implements Curator Actor hierarchy maintaining reusable library across environments.

category.term: Interpretability Culture and Human Centered Evaluation

entry.title: Subcellularly Resolved Single-Cell Embedding Learning with Transcriptomic data, Protein Structure and Localization Information

author.name: Zhen Zhou, Jiachen Li, Yuan Liu, Xiaoyong Pan, Hong-Bin Shen

entry.summary: Learns subcellularly resolved cell embeddings by fusing RNA expression, protein sequence and structure via cross attention across locations. Moves beyond holistic cell vectors to localized molecular context.

entry.title: Blending Concepts: Benchmarking Visual Metaphor Generation in Text-to-Image Models

author.name: Chuer Chen, Zichen Wang, Yi He, Zhengxi Yu, Nan Cao

entry.summary: Introduces VMetaphor-Bench with 1500 curated visual metaphors and hybrid MLLM as judge evaluation via 9594 questions. Tests text to image models on combining domains to convey abstract ideas.

category.term: Interpretability Culture and Human Centered Evaluation

entry.title: Similarity-Aware Personalized Federated Learning in Heterogeneous Environments

author.name: Arun Kumar A V, Sunil Gupta, Dang Ngyuen, Bao Duong, Dat Phan Trong

entry.summary: Proposes SAPE-FL, personalized federated learning that regularizes each client toward global model plus similarity-weighted peer average to handle heterogeneous data. Prevents collaboration from hurting local performance. Dynamic client-specific weighting.

entry.title: SocialBuddy: Tailoring Search Agent for Social Scenarios

author.name: Mingxuan Li, Yirong Mao, FaZhan Zhang, Haibiao Yao, Runze Hu, Wenhui Que

entry.summary: Introduces SocialBuddy, an agentic search framework for social feeds with a simulated environment of 200K profiles and 10M posts plus synthesis pipeline. Handles heterogeneous queries over multi-dimensional streams where generic agents degrade. First large-scale social search testbed.

category.term: Agents, Reinforcement Learning and Test-Time Compute

entry.title: Random Forest-Informed Cellular Automaton for Large-Scale Wildfire Spread Modelling

author.name: Siyu Chen, Esha Saha, Hao Wang

entry.summary: Proposes a three stage wildfire spread model combining random forest fire occurrence probabilities with a cellular automaton on a 5 km grid. Trained on 2021 Canada season and tested 2022 to 2024 with solid AUC and improved spread modeling. Matters for scalable operational forecasting under climate driven fire risk.

entry.title: Posterior Tempering Explains Variance Inflation in Linear and Generalized Linear Thompson Sampling

author.name: Prateek Jaiswal, Debdeep Pati, Anirban Bhattacharya, Bani K. Mallick

entry.summary: Studies Thompson sampling with fractional posteriors to formalize variance inflation used in prior regret analyses. Gives regularity conditions for generalized linear bandits without tractable posterior assumptions. Achieves strong regret with specific temperature scaling in dimension.

entry.title: Quantum MeanFlow: single-shot generative sampling on NISQ hardware

author.name: Ashish Joshi, Eshaan Mistry, Takahiko Koyama

entry.summary: Introduces Quantum MeanFlow for single shot generative sampling on NISQ hardware, avoiding many sequential ODE integration steps of quantum flow matching. Reduces costly sequential circuit submissions due to input output overhead. Exploratory bridge between flow matching and quantum models.

entry.title: From topology learning to graph generation: A unifying perspective

author.name: Xiaowen Dong, Hoi-To Wai, Siheng Chen, Laura Toni, Dorina Thanou

entry.summary: Offers a unifying review viewing single graph topology inference and graph generative distribution learning as inverse problems of a common generation process. Surveys methods, relations, strengths, and gaps across signal processing and ML. Useful conceptual bridge for two parallel literatures.

entry.title: Dimension Dependent Correlation Gap Bounds under Restricted Independence

author.name: Arjun Ramachandra

entry.summary: Resolves pairwise independent correlation gap questions for monotone submodular functions by proving 4 over 3 bound holds and is tight for n equals 4. Addresses prior conjecture disproved for n equals 5 by AI assisted counterexample. Pure combinatorial theory result.

entry.title: SPADE: SPaT Attack Detection from the Connected Vehicle's Perspective

author.name: James Di Novo, Hany Ragab, Sylvain P. Leblanc

entry.summary: Introduces SPADE, a dataset and detection approach for signal phase and timing attacks viewed from the connected vehicle rather than infrastructure. Covers application layer spoofs that bypass authentication when units are compromised. Fills gap beyond BSM and CAM misbehavior work.

entry.title: CoViT: Instance-Correspondence Contrastive Learning for Vision Transformer

author.name: Yisen Wang, Zhirong Wu, Limin Wang

entry.summary: Introduces CoViT, a self-supervised framework that adds instance awareness to vision transformers via geometry-guided contrastive learning. Uses attention-guided masking and hardest mining to separate identical-class instances like two dogs. Targets detection and instance segmentation transfer.

entry.title: SliceBridge: context-consistent repair of corrupted slice intervals in T1-weighted MRI

author.name: Jiheng Li, Michael E. Kim, Trent Schwartz, Gaurav Rudravaram, Derek B. Archer, Timothy J. Hohman, the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative, Lianrui Zuo, Bennett A. Landman

entry.summary: Formulates repair of corrupted slice intervals in T1 MRI as context-conditioned restoration. Proposes SliceBridge using rectified flow matching to inpaint affected slices from surrounding anatomy. Aims to salvage otherwise usable scans and reduce morphometry bias versus discarding.

entry.title: Test-Time Logit Prompting for Source-Free Missing Modality Adaptation

author.name: Taixi Chen, Nancy Guo

entry.summary: Asks whether vision-language models can be adapted at test time for missing modalities without source data. Proposes logit-level prompting to compensate for absent inputs under privacy or storage constraints. Relevant to clinical and personalized deployment.

entry.title: YesTrack: Referring Multi-Object Tracking via MLLM-based Yes/No Verification

author.name: Quansheng Hu, Qin Sun, Qiansen Dai, Jin Ding, Wan Zhang, Xue Zhou, Jianxiao Zou

entry.summary: Proposes YesTrack for referring multi-object tracking that uses a multimodal model directly for yes-no verification of language-matched tracks instead of caption generation plus external modules. Two-stage discriminative reformulation aims for latency and alignment gains. Video-language tracking.

entry.title: Doppio: A Dataset for Contactless Weight Estimation of Falling Particles

author.name: Simon Kiefhaber, Jan-Martin O. Steitz, Julia Grabinski, Christoph Reich, Paul Wagner, Max Zimmermann, Simone Schaub-Meyer, Stefan Roth

entry.summary: Introduces Doppio, a video dataset of falling ground coffee with per-frame weight ground truth for contactless mass estimation. Benchmarks spatial to temporal models for vision-based weighing. Creative industrial case study for powder handling.

entry.title: RGB-to-IR image translation for infrared vehicle detection in unseen UAV domains

author.name: Thijs A. Eker, Ella P. Fokkinga, Jan Erik van Woerden, Elfi I. S. Hofmeijer, Sebastiaan P. Snel, Klamer Schutte, Friso G. Heslinga

entry.summary: Studies whether RGB-to-IR translation can augment thermal UAV vehicle detection on unseen domains. Trains supervised GANs, ControlNet diffusion and foundation editors on paired source data and tests synthetic IR. Finds cross-modal thermal traits hard to transfer.

entry.title: Learning to Attract and Repel: Dual Quality Margin Learning for Face Recognition (DQM-Face)

author.name: El Ouanas Belabbaci, Bhavesh Wani, Philipp Terh\"orst

entry.summary: Proposes DQM-Face dual quality margin learning combining magnitude-based and semantic quality for face recognition. Refines attraction and repulsion dynamics under unconstrained noise. Aims for more reliable discriminative embeddings.

entry.title: Towards Effective Physical Reservoir Computing with a Pneumatic Soft Robot

author.name: Jeevan Hebbal Manjunath, Jun Wang, Suyi Li, Wenlong Zhang

entry.summary: Studies physical reservoir computing with pneumatic soft arm varying pouch topology, stiffness and sensor count under matched 0.2s pressure-history bending estimation. Runs 36 trials across waveforms and pressures. Derives design rules for effective reservoirs.
